text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia on Tuesday celebrates Human Rights Day.
- The Accounting High Court annual report handed to President Ben Ali on Monday.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui presented 1997 budget to the parliament. Says structural reforms will be deepened to boost competitivity.
- GDP forecast to grow 5.7 percent in 1997. State budget set at 8,010 million dinars for 1997, up 10.8 percent on 1996.
- Agriculture Minister Mohamed Ben Rejeb in Tripoli discussed cooperation with his Libyan counterpart.
